**8 Calculation of primary Class 1 contributions**

(1) Where a primary Class 1 contribution is payable, the amount of that contribution is the aggregate of—

(a) the main primary percentage of so much of the earner's earnings paid in the tax week, in respect of the employment in question, as exceeds the primary threshold but does not exceed the upper earnings limit; and

(b) the additional primary percentage of so much of those earnings as exceeds the upper earnings limit.

(2) For the purposes of this section—

(a) the main primary percentage is 8%;

(b) the additional primary percentage is 2%.

(3) The primary threshold is £242.

(4) The upper earnings limit is £967.

(5) For the meaning of “earnings” see section 3.
